security_spec.violation_condition: In the FreeBSD kernel, when a SCAUSE_BREAKPOINT exception is handled and stval is unconditionally interpreted as a valid faulting address — specifically, any code path that reads frame->tf_stval on a breakpoint exception and treats it as an authoritative faulting virtual address, when the specific breakpoint trigger type is not defined (per the ISA) to write an address to stval. This is most relevant to the bhyve/VMM trap delivery path (vmm_riscv.c:701) where stval is unconditionally captured from the hardware CSR and exposed to userspace via the vm_exit structure for every exception type including breakpoints.
security_spec.summary: Sstvala clarification: kernel must not assume stval contains a valid address for all breakpoint exceptions — only those explicitly defined to write one; unconditional stval capture in bhyve trap delivery risks exposing stale CSR values to userspace
